transactions.deleteConfirmDesc: This will permanently delete this transaction. This action cannot be undone.
transactions.purchaseDetail.title: What this transaction bought
transactions.purchaseDetail.unavailable: The purchases pillar could not be reached, so what this transaction bought is unknown right now. The transaction itself is unaffected.
transactions.purchaseDetail.empty: No order is linked to this transaction. That is the ordinary answer for most of a statement, not a fault.
transactions.purchaseDetail.accountedFor: Orders account for {{linked}} of this transaction’s {{total}}.
transactions.purchaseDetail.fullyAccount: Every cent of this transaction is accounted for.
transactions.purchaseDetail.unaccounted: {{amount}} of this transaction is not accounted for by any order.
transactions.purchaseDetail.overAccounte: Orders claim {{amount}} more than this transaction is worth.
transactions.purchaseDetail.mixedCurrenc: These orders settled in more than one currency ({{currencies}}), so they do not add up to one total.
How much of this transaction is left unaccounted for cannot be stated across currencies. Each order’s share is shown below in the currency it settled in.
transactions.purchaseDetail.autoLinkedHi: Matched automatically and confirmed by nobody — a later sweep may withdraw it.
transactions.purchaseLink.confirmedHint: Somebody confirmed the order behind this transaction.
transactions.purchaseLink.partlyConfirme: Some of what this transaction paid for was confirmed by hand and some was matched automatically.
transactions.purchaseLink.unavailableHin: Purchases could not be answered, so this column may be incomplete — an empty cell here does not mean the transaction has no order.
